args: for r in "$DESK_PLUGIN_ROOT" "$PWD"; do if [ -f "$r/launch/desk-node.sh" ]; then DESK_PLUGIN_ROOT=$r; export DESK_PLUGIN_ROOT; exec sh "$r/launch/desk-node.sh" --mcp "$r/mcp/index.js"; fi; done; t='{\"state\":\"degraded:plugin_root_missing\",\"fix\":\"Desk could not find its plugin files from this MCP launch. Refresh or reinstall the Desk plugin, then reconnect the Desk MCP server.\"}'; while IFS= read -r l || [ -n "$l" ]; do  i=$(printf '%s' "$l" | sed -nE 's/.*"id"[[:space:]]*:[[:space:]]*("[^"]*"|-?[0-9]+).*/\1/p'); [ -n "$i" ] || continue;  v=$(printf '%s' "$l" | sed -nE 's/.*"protocolVersion"[[:space:]]*:[[:space:]]*"([0-9A-Za-z.-]*)".*/\1/p'); [ -n "$v" ] || v=2025-06-18;  case $(printf '%s' "$l" | sed -nE 's/.*"method"[[:space:]]*:[[:space:]]*"([^"]*)".*/\1/p') in  initialize) x='{"protocolVersion":"'$v'","capabilities":{"tools":{}},"serverInfo":{"name":"desk-mcp-plugin-root-missing","version":"0.0.0"}}';;  ping) x='{}';;  tools/list) x='{"tools":[{"name":"desk_status","description":"Report why Desk could not start.","inputSchema":{"type":"object","properties":{},"additionalProperties":true}}]}';;  tools/call) x='{"content":[{"type":"text","text":"'$t'"}]}';;  *) printf '{"jsonrpc":"2.0","id":%s,"error":{"code":-32601,"message":"Method not found"}}\n' "$i"; continue;;  esac;  printf '{"jsonrpc":"2.0","id":%s,"result":%s}\n' "$i" "$x"; done
